bihar_raw_news.title: Colt DCS, RMZ begin construction of 64 MW Mumbai data centre - ET Datacenters
bihar_raw_news.content: Investments & Deals 1 min Read Colt DCS, RMZ begin construction of 64 MW Mumbai data centre Colt Data Centre Services and RMZ have started building their third data centre, Mumbai 3, in Navi Mumbai. This facility will add 64 MW of AI-ready capacity to their campus, increasing its operational capacity to 86 MW. ETDatacenters Published On Oct 16, 2026 at 09:00 AM IST Select ETDatacenters as Preferred Choice on Google Share Icon Copy Link Share on Whatsapp Share on Linkedin Share on X Share on Telegram Share on Facebook Bookmark Comment Highlights Colt DCS and RMZ commenced construction of Mumbai 3 data centre in Navi Mumbai. The facility will add 64 MW of AI-ready capacity, boosting campus total to 86 MW. The joint venture plans to invest $1.7 billion for 250 MW across India. Mumbai 3 will support hyperscale customers with liquid cooling and renewable energy. Colt Data Centre Services ( Colt DCS ) and Bengaluru-based RMZ have begun constructing their third data centre in Navi Mumbai . The Mumbai 3 facility will deliver 64 MW of AI-ready data centre capacity upon completion, the companies announced on Thursday. This development will increase the Navi Mumbai campus's operational capacity to 86 MW. The campus has the potential to deliver up to 148 MW of capacity at full development, the companies said. Colt DCS and RMZ operate as a joint venture, which announced plans in 2024 to invest $1.7 billion in the Indian data centre market. They aim to develop 250 MW of data centre capacity across Mumbai and Chennai. Construction for Mumbai 3 is now underway following the signing of the facility’s first hyperscale customer, the companies said. Ground preparation for the facility began in December 2025. Pratap Mane, country head, DCS, India, stated that data centre demand is evolving rapidly. Customers require larger deployments, higher rack densities, and infrastructure to support intensive AI workloads. The Mumbai 3 facility incorporates advanced cooling capabilities, including liquid cooling . It also features enhanced power infrastructure to support high-density deployments, Mane added. This design enables customers to scale AI and high-performance computing workloads efficiently while maintaining operational resilience. Deepak Chhabria, president at RMZ Digital Infrastructure , said the campus is designed for hyperscalers and neo-cloud providers. It will enable them to scale seamlessly as their capacity and computing needs evolve. The companies also stated that the facility will operate using 100 per cent renewable energy . It has been designed with a closed-loop cooling system, enabling near-zero wastewater from the cooling process. The project is expected to create more than 700 jobs across construction and operations. Comments What are your thoughts?

national_raw_news.title: 5 hours ago | National 115 ECI directs 17 States & UTs to conduct Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls with 1st ...
national_raw_news.content: The Election Commission has directed 17 States and Union Territories to conduct a Special Summary Revision (SSR) of electoral rolls with 1st January next year as the qualifying date. These states and UTs are Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Goa, Gujarat, Kerala, Lakshadweep, Madhya Pradesh, Manipur, Puducherry, Punjab, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and West Bengal. The Commission said in its letter that it had issued instructions on the 29th of September to undertake a special drive for the enrolment of left-out, young and first-time eligible electors. EC also said that the schedule for SSR in States and UTs where the Special Intensive Revision is ongoing or has recently been completed will be announced later. It added that for Himachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh, where SIR has not been started so far, the schedule for roll revision will be announced in due course of time. The Commission further said that the Electoral Registration Officer of the concerned assembly constituency shall be responsible for ensuring that no eligible citizen is left out while no ineligible person gets included or remains in the Electoral Roll. During the Special Summary Revision, the Chief Electoral Officer, District Election Officers, and Electoral Registration Officers will ensure that every eligible person is enrolled as an elector. Our correspondent reports that since the revision is a Summary Revision in nature, there will be no house-to-house visits by Booth Level Officers to electors. In order to ensure maximum participation of the young and first-time voters, all prospective electors eligible on 1st January 2027 and those who become eligible on 1st April 2027, 1st July 2027, and 1st October 2027 can also send their advance applications for enrolment. Help desks will be set up at the district level to facilitate enrolment of electors, especially migrants, the vulnerable, and marginalised.

national_raw_news.title: APEDA facilitates export of 1.755 tonnes of organic Palmyra jaggery powder from Tamil Nadu to Bulgaria. 21 mins ago 14
national_raw_news.content: The Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA) facilitated Export of 1.755 MT of Organic Palmyra Jaggery Powder from Tamil Nadu to Bulgaria. The consignment of National Programme for Organic Production and EU-certified organic Palmyra Jaggery Powder was dispatched yesterday from Erode district of Tamil Nadu to Varna, Bulgaria. The Ministry of Commerce and Industry said the consignment marks an important step towards introducing India’s traditional Palmyra-based products to international markets and diversifying the country’s organic export basket. It said that the initiative, which covers 137 acres under organic cultivation, seeks to link Tamil Nadu’s traditional Palmyra-based products market internationally, creating new opportunities for farmers engaged in the organic cultivation. The Ministry highlighted that by developing export-ready products from this resource, the initiative is set to expand market opportunities while supporting producers and the wider value chain. The ministry also noted that the consignment will be shipped by sea through Chennai Port. Derived from Palmyra blossom nectar, Palmyra Jaggery Powder is a better alternative to refined sugar as it offers potential nutritional benefits, including vitamins and minerals. The Palmyra-based products including Jaggery Powder are associated with traditional production practices and the use of the Palmyra palm, which has long been part of the agricultural and cultural landscape of Tamil Nadu.

national_raw_news.title: Mizoram CM Lalduhoma launches 4 digital financial management initiatives to enhance transparency & accountability. 60 mins ago 19
national_raw_news.content: Mizoram Chief Minister Lalduhoma has launched four major digital financial management initiatives of the state government implemented under the Finance Department, which aim to strengthen transparency, accountability and efficiency in the management of public finances. Mizoram Integrated Works Accounts System (MIWAS) will streamline works accounts in six departments – Public Works Department (PWD), Public Health Engineering Department (PHE), Power & Electricity Department (P&E), Irrigation & Water Resources Department (IWRD), Environment, Forest & Climate Change Department (EFCC), and Land Resources, Soil & Water Conservation Department (LRS&WC). It will improve the reconciliation of expenditure figures submitted to the Accountant General and ensure proper submission of expenditure vouchers through the Treasury. The e-Budget Module will enable online preparation and submission of budget proposals through IFMIS, reducing manual work, calculation errors and delays in processing. The e-Sanction Module will facilitate the online processing of expenditure sanctions, enabling proposals to be forwarded electronically from Drawing and Disbursing Officers and Heads of Departments to the concerned Administrative Departments and the Finance Department. It will also help prevent expenditure beyond the available budget. Under 100% DBT, payments under State schemes, including Thlai Thar Leina (funds for purchase of cash crops), Bana Kaih (handholding scheme) and Power Subsidy, will be transferred directly to beneficiaries’ bank accounts after the Treasury passes the bills. Payment status will also be trackable through IFMIS. Addressing the gathering, the Chief Minister highlighted the importance of digital financial management in ensuring transparency and efficient utilisation of public funds. He noted that Mizoram received Rs. 350 crore under SASCI Part IX in the previous year and is preparing to secure approximately Rs. 650 crore under SASCI Part IV and Part IX during 2026-27. The initiatives mark another step towards modernizing financial administration and improving public service delivery in Mizoram.

national_raw_news.title: Ayush innovation sees eightfold rise in patent filings - ANI News
national_raw_news.content: Ayush innovation sees eightfold rise in patent filings Toggle navigation हिंदी खबर Ayush innovation sees eightfold rise in patent filings ANI | Updated: Oct 16, 2026 18:06 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel New Delhi [India], October 16 (ANI): Ayush-related innovation and intellectual property activity in India has expanded significantly over the past decade, with 4,077 patent applications filed and 711 patents granted between FY 2014-15 and FY 2025-26, according to the Status Report on Ayush Related Inventions in India (2014-2026) released during the celebrations of the 11th Ayurveda Day. Published by the Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trademarks (CGPDTM), Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry, the report provides an overview of the evolution of Ayush-related inventions and intellectual property activity in India during the period. Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Ayush and Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare Prataprao Jadhav , reiterated, “The substantial growth in Ayush-related patent filings and grants reflects the increasing focus on research, innovation and intellectual property in the Ayush sector. The Government is committed to creating an enabling ecosystem where traditional knowledge, scientific research and contemporary innovation can contribute to new products, technologies and solutions while ensuring that India’s rich knowledge systems are appropriately protected.” Vaidya Rajesh Kotecha, Secretary, Ministry of Ayush, emphasised, “The steady expansion of patent activity demonstrates the growing research and innovation base of the Ayush sector. The increasing participation of individuals, universities, research institutions, startups and industry is encouraging and will help strengthen the translation of research into innovative solutions. The Ministry will continue to support evidence generation, research collaboration and innovation across the Ayush ecosystem.” The release stated that the report highlighted a sharp increase in annual patent filings, from 63 applications in FY 2014-15 to 590 in FY 2025-26, representing a growth of around 836.5 per cent. Filings peaked at 606 applications in FY 2022-23 before falling to 299 in FY 2023-24 and recovering to 590 in FY 2025-26. Annual patent grants also increased substantially, from three in FY 2015-16 to 204 in FY 2023-24, with Maharashtra leading the patent activity with 744 filings and 142 grants. The expanding innovation ecosystem is reflected in the diversity of applicants. Natural persons accounted for 2,113 applications, or 51.9 per cent of total filings, and 398 grants, while educational institutions contributed 995 applications and 88 grants. Together, natural persons and educational institutions accounted for 76.3 per cent of total filings. Corporate and other entities accounted for 700 applications and 176 grants, while small entities and startups contributed 144 and 125 filings, respectively. The findings of the report underline the growing integration of research, innovation, entrepreneurship and intellectual property protection within the Ayush ecosystem, with increasing participation from individual innovators, educational institutions, research organisations, startups and industry, the press release said. national_raw_news.content: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship National Steering Committee Approves ₹1,194.92 Crore Investment Under PM-SETU for Five ITI Clusters Across Maharashtra, Odisha and Jammu & Kashmir Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, Belrise Industries, Eagle Infra India and Inderdeep Infra India to partner in upgrading five ITI clusters; cumulative investment approved under PM-SETU reaches ₹3,687 crore Posted On: 16 OCT 2026 3:25PM by PIB Delhi The 6th National Steering Committee (NSC) meeting of the Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs (PM-SETU) was held today under the chairpersonship of Smt. Debashree Mukherjee, Secretary, Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE). The Committee reviewed the progress of the scheme and approved five Strategic Investment Plans (SIPs) worth ₹1,194.92 crore for ITI clusters across Maharashtra, Odisha and Jammu & Kashmir. With these approvals, the cumulative investment approved under PM-SETU has reached ₹3,687 crore till date, marking another significant milestone in the Government of India's efforts to transform Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) into modern, industry-aligned and future-ready skill institutions. The meeting was attended by senior officials from the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), including Shri Niranjan Kumar Sudhanshu, Additional Secretary, MSDE, and Smt. Manasi Sahay Thakur, Joint Secretary, MSDE, along with representatives from the Directorate General of Training (DGT), State Governments and Union Territories, industry partners, multilateral development banks (MDBs), and other stakeholders associated with the implementation of PM-SETU. Charing the meeting Ms. Debashree Mukherjee Secretary MSDE said, “The approvals given by the National Steering Committee are an important step in implementing PM-SETU. They will help strengthen ITIs, improve training and increase industry participation. We encourage clusters to work towards ISO certification and include at least one WorldSkills-aligned trade or competency area in their Approved Implementation Plans. Our aim is to improve training quality and help young people gain skills that lead to better employment opportunities. The progress made by Jammu & Kashmir is encouraging and reflects a strong commitment to strengthening skilling and expanding opportunities for youth in the region.” The approved Strategic Investment Plans will be implemented through partnerships between State Governments, industry partners and participating ITIs under the PM-SETU framework. The projects will focus on modernising infrastructure, introducing industry-aligned courses, strengthening trainer capacity, enhancing industry engagement and improving employability outcomes for youth. The approved clusters are as follows: Kataka ITI Cluster in Odisha to be Upgraded in Partnership with Tata Steel Foundation The National Steering Committee approved a Strategic Investment Plan worth ₹240.50 crore for the Kataka ITI Cluster in Odisha in partnership with Tata Steel Foundation. The cluster comprises Government ITI Kataka as the Hub and Madhusudan Government ITI Choudwar, Government ITI Paradeep, Government ITI Jajpur and Government ITI Dhenkanal as Spokes. The project aims to strengthen infrastructure, introduce new-age training programmes and enhance industry linkages to meet the emerging skill requirements of the region. national_raw_news.title: Govt clears Rs 1195 crore investment plans to upgrade 25 ITIs in Maharashtra, Odisha, J&K
national_raw_news.content: Govt clears Rs 1,195 crore investment plans to upgrade 25 ITIs in Maharashtra, Odisha, J&K Toggle navigation हिंदी खबर Govt clears Rs 1,195 crore investment plans to upgrade 25 ITIs in Maharashtra, Odisha, J&K ANI | Updated: Oct 16, 2026 16:17 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel New Delhi [India], October 16 (ANI): The government has approved investment plans worth Rs 1,194.92 crore to upgrade 25 Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) across Maharashtra, Odisha and Jammu & Kashmir in partnership with five industry players, including Tata Steel Foundation and Belrise Industries, to strengthen vocational training and youth employability. The approvals were given at the sixth National Steering Committee meeting of the Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs (PM-SETU) scheme on Friday, according to the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship . With the latest approvals, cumulative investment cleared under the scheme has reached Rs 3,687 crore. The five approved plans cover ITI clusters in Pune and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar in Maharashtra, Kataka in Odisha, and Jammu and Srinagar in Jammu & Kashmir. Each cluster comprises one hub ITI and four associated institutes. "The approvals given by the National Steering Committee are an important step in implementing PM-SETU. They will help strengthen ITIs, improve training and increase industry participation," said Debashree Mukherjee, Secretary, Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship . Among the approved projects, Pune received Rs 241 crore in partnership with BVG India, while Odisha's Kataka cluster received Rs 240.50 crore in partnership with Tata Steel Foundation. The Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar cluster was approved for Rs 238.01 crore with Belrise Industries, while the Jammu and Srinagar clusters received Rs 240 crore and Rs 235.41 crore, respectively, in partnership with Eagle Infra India and Inderdeep Infra India. The projects will focus on upgrading infrastructure, introducing industry-aligned courses, improving trainer capacity and strengthening industry participation to bridge gaps between vocational training and employers' skill requirements. Mukherjee also urged clusters to pursue ISO certification and include at least one WorldSkills-aligned trade or competency area in their implementation plans. The committee also reviewed the Training of Trainers programme, under which 3,744 trainers had been trained through National Skill Training Institutes as of October 2026. national_raw_news.content: Paras Health network grows 42.5% over two years, ranks 3rd nationally Paras Health network grows 42.5% over two years, ranks 3rd nationally ANI 15 Oct 2026, 13:35 GMT+10 VMPL Gurugram (Haryana) [India], October 15: IPO-bound Paras Health has been ranked joint third alongside Manipal Hospitals in the National Group Ranking 2026 for private multispeciality hospital groups. The network of eight hospitals recorded a 42.5% increase in inpatient volumes and a 31.3% rise in surgeries between FY2024 and FY2026, according to its June 2026 draft abridged prospectus. Apollo Hospitals placed first and Fortis Healthcare second. The survey assessed eligible groups as integrated networks, so Paras's position applies to the group as a whole rather than to individual hospitals. The ranking comes as organised private hospital chains expand through new facilities, additional beds and acquisitions. ICRA's July 2026 update projected revenue growth of 13-15% in FY2027 for its sample of hospital companies, following 18% growth in FY2026. Separately, Crisil Ratings' February assessment of 98 private hospitals forecast more than 10,000 bed additions through new facilities and expansions of existing hospitals across FY2026 and FY2027. Expansion is taking place alongside improving financial coverage and continuing pressure on households. The government's 2025 health survey found insurance or financing-scheme coverage had reached 47.4% in rural India and 44.3% in urban areas. National Health Accounts estimates for FY2022-23, released in May 2026, show households still paid 43.4% of total health expenditure directly. For hospital networks, these figures underline the importance of affordability and access alongside increasing capacity. ( pib.gov.in , pib.gov.in ) Hospital chains also face the task of recruiting and retaining specialist doctors and nurses, developing referral systems and maintaining reliable diagnostics. As networks grow, providers must balance spending on clinical teams, equipment and new facilities with the need to keep treatment accessible and sustain standards across locations. Dr Dharminder Kumar Nagar, Managing Director, Paras Health, said, "Sharing third place in the national hospital group ranking is an important milestone for Paras Health. Our growth in inpatient volumes and surgeries brings a responsibility to strengthen the clinical teams and infrastructure supporting that care. We are focused on building specialist capabilities and critical care capacity across our hospitals, while maintaining consistent standards as more patients use our network." Paras's inpatient volumes reached 115,496 in FY2026, compared with 81,047 in FY2024. The filing counts patients admitted and subsequently discharged during the relevant period. Surgeries increased to 39,687 from 30,219, while outpatient consultation visits rose 36.8% to 778,707 from 569,139 over the same two years. Revenue from operations increased 24.1% year on year to approximately 1,606 crore in FY2026 from 1,294 crore in FY2025. The group reported a consolidated profit after tax of 43.83 crore in FY2026, compared with a loss of 57.98 crore a year earlier. Overall bed occupancy rose to 61.75% in FY2026 from 52.46% in FY2024. As of March 31, 2026, Paras reported 1,502 operational beds, up from 1,332 two years earlier. ICU beds increased to 559 from 425 over the same period. These figures...

national_raw_news.title: MoD inks Rs 4,106 crore contracts for GSAT-7C communication satellite and Varunastra ...
national_raw_news.content: MoD inks Rs 4,106 crore contracts for GSAT-7C communication satellite and Varunastra Heavy Weight Torpedoes Toggle navigation हिंदी खबर MoD inks Rs 4,106 crore contracts for GSAT-7C communication satellite and Varunastra Heavy Weight Torpedoes ANI | Updated: Oct 15, 2026 18:55 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel New Delhi [India], October 15 (ANI): The Ministry of Defence has signed contracts worth a total of approximately Rs 4,106 crore for the acquisition of a dedicated communication satellite capability, GSAT-7C for the Indian Air Force, and Varunastra Heavy Weight Torpedoes for the Indian Navy . The contract for GSAT-7C, valued at Rs 2,563 crore, was inked with New Space India Limited, Bengaluru. This indigenously designed, developed & manufactured satellite will enhance the secure, resilient & seamless communication capabilities for the assets of the Indian Air Force, thereby strengthening operational effectiveness, said the Ministry of Defence . The contract for Varunastra was signed with Bharat Dynamics Limited, Hyderabad worth Rs 1,543 crore. Varunastra is an indigenous ship-launched anti-submarine torpedo developed by the Naval Science and Technological Laboratory. Equipped with advanced maneuvering capabilities, it is capable of engaging enemy submarines at long ranges, thereby enhancing the anti-submarine warfare capability of the Indian Navy . The contracts were signed in the presence of Additional Secretary and Director General (Acquisition), Department of Defence A Anbarasu in New Delhi on October 15, 2026. Both contracts mark a significant step towards advancing the development of domestic defence manufacturing capabilities while promoting self-reliance in critical technologies in line with the Government’s ‘Aatmanirbhar Bharat’ and ‘Make-in-India’ vision. Last week, the Ministry of Defence signed a contract with BrahMos Aerospace Private Limited (BAPL) for procurement of BrahMos Fire Control System and Launchers for Indian Navy ships under the Buy (Indian-IDDM) Category, on Monday in New Delhi. According to a release from the Ministry of Defence , valued at Rs 661.50 crore, the contract was inked in the presence of Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh. With a minimum of 68% indigenous content, the project encourages active participation of various Indian industries, including MSMEs. The project will generate employment over a period of three years. It also bolsters India’s maritime security architecture and defence capabilities and marks a critical milestone in the ongoing efforts to indigenise advanced military technology.
